cohort: The study compared 228 monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies with 598 dichorionic twin pregnancies.
finding: Monochorionic pregnancies exhibited higher rates of obstetrical complications, including earlier gestational ages at delivery and lower birthweights, compared to dichorionic pregnancies, though perinatal outcomes were similar when considering only uncomplicated pregnancies.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 47.4% of monochorionic pregnancies and 43.1% of dichorionic pregnancies.
